items.title: Doc convention da co (Button, cn, theme-provider, section id pattern tu hero)
items.notes: Section dung id='hero' de scroll-to; tiep tuc pattern nay cho cac section khac (about, skills, experience, education-contact).

items.title: ThemeToggle component (light/dark/system) dung next-themes
items.notes: ThemeToggle: cycle light->dark->system, dung useSyncExternalStore cho mount-detection (thay useState+useEffect de tranh loi lint set-state-in-effect).

items.title: Navbar: sticky, active-section highlight (IntersectionObserver), mobile drawer
items.notes: Navbar sticky, active-section qua IntersectionObserver (rootMargin -40%/-50% de tranh flicker), mobile drawer voi focus trap thu cong (Tab/Shift+Tab wrap, Escape to close, focus link dau khi mo).

items.title: Footer voi social links
items.notes: Footer voi mailto/tel/LinkedIn that. Bo link GitHub placeholder vi CV khong co GitHub URL that - tranh hien thi lien ket gia.

items.title: Wire Navbar+Footer vao layout.tsx
items.notes: Navbar+Footer wire vao RootLayout, bao children.

items.title: A11y: aria-label, aria-expanded, focus trap drawer
items.notes: aria-label tren nav/button, aria-expanded tren hamburger, aria-current tren nav link active, role=dialog+aria-modal tren drawer.
